text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I don't have a shell here, so I worked by reading each test against its code. Please run the suite to confirm everything passes. I didn't change any tests.

- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added the daily rate instead of multiplying by it. It's now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`members.py`**: the borrowing limit was 3, but the policy comment and the tests both say 5. Changed `MAX_BORROWED` to 5.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It now returns the last `n` events (`_history[-n:]`). I also made it return an empty list when `n <= 0`, because `[-0:]` would otherwise return the whole history. No test covers that case.
- **`factory.py`**: the sample catalog was missing `Emma`. I added it with author Austen, year 1815 and 1 copy. The tests only check the title, so the other details are my choice.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` kept the year as text. It now converts it to a number, so `age()` works.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.
